turn: I finished validating meter reading imports by adding a test in tests/readings/test_validate.py that checks a drop in the index is rejected. The test calls check_monotonic with a previous reading of 100 and a new reading of 90 for meter M1. It expects an IndexDrop error to be raised. I haven't run the test suite in this session, so the test is written but not confirmed passing. In the same commit I also made a small unplanned fix. I noticed the test file had an unused import left over from an earlier draft, and I removed it to keep the file clean. Next I will start "Estimate missing readings".
